mapper.update: update workflow set workflow_name = #{workflowName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, current_published_version_id = #{currentPublishedVersionId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from workflow where id = #{id} limit 1

select count(1) from workflow
